# Contract: meeting-notes-to-tasks

Third-party skill from [DevelopersGlobal/ai-agent-skills](https://github.com/DevelopersGlobal/ai-agent-skills) (MIT, DevelopersGlobal), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Meeting notes turned into owned, dated tasks). The method is upstream. Category: planning. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Turn meeting notes or a transcript into decisions and action items with an owner and a date.

## Use it for
- "turn these meeting notes into tasks"
- "who does what by when"

## Not for
- one personal next action from a brain dump (next-step)
- a case study (work-to-explanation)

## Accepted inputs
Notes or a transcript of a meeting.

## Deliverables
A decision list and action items with owner, date, and one line of context.

## Human decisions
- The date, when the notes only say soon

## Quality checks
- Every action has an owner and a calendar date
- Discussions are not listed as decisions

## Common failures
